Vendor / workday hcm cost

Workday HCM pricing in 2026

Workday HCM does not publish list. Buying-committee evidence at 1,000-5,000 employees puts annual per-employee subscription at $25-$45 PEPM. Systems-integrator implementation (Deloitte, Kainos, Accenture) commonly runs $250,000-$1.5M and frequently exceeds the year-1 subscription line. Multi-year contracts (3 to 5 years) are standard.

What the buying committee actually pays

Implementation is the dominant year-1 line item. SI fees often exceed software subscription in year 1. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

What is real per-employee annual cost at 1,000 and 5,000?

At 1,000 employees, $25-$45 PEPM equates to $300-$540 per employee per year, or $300K-$540K annual subscription. At 5,000 employees, volume discounts pull PEPM closer to $20-$30, equating to $1.2M-$1.8M annual subscription.

What is a typical Workday implementation fee?

$250,000 to $1,500,000 for SI-led implementation. Deloitte, Kainos, and Accenture are the three most-common partners; specialist boutiques (Alight, Cloudpaths) compete on the lower band.

How does Workday bundle modules?

Core HCM is the foundation. Payroll, Recruiting, Learning, Adaptive Planning, and Strategic Sourcing are paid SKUs on top. Workday Compensation and Talent Optimization are commonly bundled with Core in enterprise quotes.

What is the typical contract minimum?

3-year MSA is the floor; 5-year is common with named-account discounts of 15-25% baked in.

When does Workday make sense over UKG Pro or Oracle HCM?

When global multi-country employer footprint, complex matrix reporting, and Workday Adaptive financial planning integration are decision drivers. UKG wins on workforce-management (scheduling, time, deskless workforce); Oracle wins on existing Oracle Financials integration.
